name: Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine
summary: Troggs hold Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine beneath the quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. Dwarves of Ironforge mined its tunnels for stone and rich ore until their picks broke into trogg caverns. Now Hammerspine leads the warband in the deepest shafts.

sections.title: A Breach in the Deep
sections.body: The dwarves' pickaxes broke through a wall into caverns where troggs dwelled. Their mining ended there. Troggs poured from the darkness, overwhelmed the crews, and drove them from the mine. The abandoned shafts remain in trogg hands.

sections.title: Lair of Hammerspine
sections.body: Younger troggs roam the quarry's sunlit terraces, but the mine shelters the warband's fiercest fighters. Deep in its cramped tunnels lurks Hammerspine, their vicious chieftain. Local mountaineers still need to reclaim the valuable quarry. To do so, they must reach the mine's deepest shafts and cut off the troggs at their source.

faq.q: Why is the mine full of troggs?
aliases: why are troggs in gol bolar
faq.answer: Dwarven miners broke into a hidden cavern as they dug. Troggs swarmed through the breach, slaughtered some miners and drove the rest out, then claimed the shafts.

faq.q: Who leads the troggs inside Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine?
faq.answer: Hammerspine leads the troggs in Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine. The hulking brute commands the warband's strongest fighters deep in the shafts.

faq.q: Is the mine different from the rest of the quarry?
faq.answer: Yes. Weaker troggs roam the outer quarry pit, while the deep, cramped tunnels hold the toughest fighters and their chieftain.
No. Mining has stopped. Dwarven mountaineers and adventurers now fight to drive out the troggs instead of gathering stone.

angles.text: Each swing of a pick into the mountain risks waking what lies beneath. Reclaiming Gol'Bolar Mine would restore its value and dwarven pride.
Hostile troggs still block the mine. Its deepest tunnels must be cleared before miners can return.
